description: Classic layout: cross-cloud cost allocation tables and bars, security→cost (crypto / S3), usage-to-cost correlation, and LLM observability tables. The baseline dashboard is meridian-finops-llm-observability.
title: [Meridian] FinOps & LLM Observability — classic

panels.title: FinOps integration — native cloud provider dashboards

config.content:
These are the **out-of-the-box Elastic integration dashboards** installed from Fleet packages (`aws_billing`, `gcp`, `azure_billing`, `openai`, `anthropic_metrics`, `azure_openai`, `aws_bedrock`, `gcp_vertexai`, `apm`). Open them with the same time range.

This Meridian dashboard is the cross-provider overlay; provider packs remain the source of truth for CUR line items, PTU, Guardrails, etc.

Elastic AI Assistant / Agent Builder usage and the managed inference token dashboard are linked at right.

## Meridian Dynamics — FinOps & LLM Observability

Cost allocation across AWS accounts, GCP projects, and Azure subscriptions, correlated with infrastructure usage, plus end-to-end LLM traces (tokens, cost, latency, quality) for every application flow.

Time range is stored with the dashboard (**2026-04-29 – 2026-08-27 (computed at publish)**). Republish after backfill to refresh.

**Baseline (stacked bars/areas):** [FinOps & LLM Observability](#/view/meridian-finops-llm-observability).

**Scenario callouts:** cost leak on `meridian-staging` · crypto mining (−12..−9, `meridian-dev`) · S3 exposure (−6..−4) · ML burn (−20..−16, GCP) · GenAI ramp (from −15) · LLM agent-loop (`checkout-assistant`) · model migration (`support-copilot` openai→anthropic) · cache-miss (`rag-research`).

**Budget posture:** spend SLOs + ES|QL alerts — see the Budget posture section or [Observability SLOs](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/observability/slos).

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost)

FROM metrics-gcp.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(gcp.billing.total)

FROM metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(azure.billing.pretax_cost)

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS cost = SUM(cost)

FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default, metrics-gcp.billing-default, metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL cost = COALESCE(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost, gcp.billing.total, azure.billing.pretax_cost)
| EVAL provider = data_stream.dataset
| STATS cost = SUM(cost) BY provider
| SORT cost DESC

FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default, metrics-gcp.billing-default, metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL cost = COALESCE(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost, gcp.billing.total, azure.billing.pretax_cost)
| EVAL provider = data_stream.dataset
| STATS cost = SUM(cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d), provider
| SORT day

panels.title: Security → cost — crypto mining & S3 exposure

config.content:
## Security incidents that move spend

**Crypto-mining** (days −12..−9, `meridian-dev`): GuardDuty `CryptoCurrency:EC2/BitcoinTool.B`, CloudTrail brute-force from `185.220.101.34`, CPU pegged, EC2 cost spike.

**S3 public exposure** (days −6..−4, fintech): `Policy:S3/BucketAnonymousAccessGranted`, `PutBucketPolicy`, anonymous scrapes of `meridian-fintech-exports`, data-transfer cost.

Open OOTB GuardDuty / CloudTrail Discover with the same time range for drill-down.

data_source.query:
FROM logs-aws.guardduty-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS findings = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-aws.guardduty-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND rule.name LIKE "CryptoCurrency*"
| STATS crypto = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-aws.guardduty-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND rule.name LIKE "Policy:S3*"
| STATS s3_findings = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-aws.cloudtrail-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND source.ip == "185.220.101.34"
| STATS events = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-aws.guardduty-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS findings = COUNT(*) BY finding = rule.name
| SORT findings DESC
| LIMIT 12

FROM logs-aws.cloudtrail-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND (event.action LIKE "*Bucket*" OR event.action LIKE "*Object*")
| STATS calls = COUNT(*) BY action = event.action
| SORT calls DESC
| LIMIT 12

FROM logs-aws.guardduty-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, rule.name, aws.guardduty.severity.value, cloud.account.id
| LIMIT 40

config.content: Allocation dimensions from native billing integrations: AWS CUR (`usage_account_name`, `product`, `resource_tags`, region), GCP project/service/region, Azure subscription/department/product/region, and Cost Explorer `cost_center` tags (untagged bucket = `cost_center$`).

| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY service = aws_billing.cur.product.product
| SORT cost DESC
| LIMIT 12

panels.title: Engineering & Ops — usage correlated with cost

config.content: Infrastructure usage (EC2 network throughput, CloudTrail API volume) plotted alongside CUR EC2 spend so ops can see whether cost moves with work. Watch `meridian-staging` for the cost-leak pattern (spend without matching activity).

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND aws_billing.cur.product.product == "AmazonEC2"
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-aws.ec2_metrics-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS network_in = SUM(aws.ec2.metrics.NetworkIn.rate) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM logs-aws.cloudtrail-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS api_calls = COUNT() BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-aws.ec2_metrics-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS network_in = SUM(aws.ec2.metrics.NetworkIn.rate) BY account = cloud.account.name
| SORT network_in DESC

config.title: AWS cost vs usage quantity by account and product

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost), usage = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.usage_amount) BY account = aws_billing.cur.line_item.usage_account_name, service = aws_billing.cur.product.product
| EVAL unit_cost = cost / usage
| SORT cost DESC

config.content: Daily CUR history plus a trailing 7-day average run-rate. `projected_30d` = last-7-day daily average × 30 (not a statistical model — a FinOps run-rate).

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS daily = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day DESC
| LIMIT 7
| STATS avg_7d = AVG(daily)

FROM metrics-aws_billing.cur-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS daily = SUM(aws_billing.cur.line_item.unblended_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day DESC
| LIMIT 7
| STATS avg_7d = AVG(daily)
| EVAL projected_30d = avg_7d * 30
| KEEP projected_30d

FROM metrics-gcp.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(gcp.billing.total) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM metrics-azure.billing-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS cost = SUM(azure.billing.pretax_cost) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

config.content:
## Budget posture

Meridian treats cloud + LLM spend as error budgets. Thresholds come from `config/budgets.yaml` (intentionally tight so the seeded timeline shows breaches).

- **AWS monthly budget:** $150,000 · **AWS daily SLO ceiling:** $5,200
- **Staging daily SLO ceiling:** $150 (cost_leak)
- **checkout-assistant 7d alert floor:** $4.00 (agent-loop)

[Observability SLOs](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/observability/slos) · [Observability Alerts](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/observability/alerts) · [Alerting rules](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/management/insightsAndAlerting/triggersActions/rules)

**Meridian FinOps AI Assistant:** [Open in Agent Builder](https://klgllmobs-bb1595.kb.us-central1.gcp.elastic.cloud/app/agent_builder/chat) (agent `meridian-finops-ai-assistant`). Provision: `python -m src.cli agent` · `python -m src.cli budgets`.

| EVAL budget = 150000.0, min = 0, max = budget * 2, goal = budget

panels.title: LLM traces — end-to-end call, tokens, and cost

config.content:
APM `gen_ai` spans (`traces-apm-default`) carry prompt/completion/total tokens, model, system, latency, outcome, and `labels.llm_cost_usd`. `trace.id` is the request id — open APM to inspect the parent FastAPI transaction.

**LLM scenarios:** agent-loop burn on `checkout-assistant` (−8..−6) · model migration on `support-copilot` (openai→anthropic at −14) · cache-miss storm on `rag-research` (−5..−3) · skunkworks GenAI ramp.

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS calls = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens)

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS prompt = SUM(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens)

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS completion = SUM(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens)

config.title: Recent LLM calls — trace, model, tokens, cost, latency

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost_usd = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd), latency_ms = span.duration.us / 1000.0
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, trace.id, service.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.system, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, gen_ai.usage.total_tokens, cost_usd, latency_ms, event.outcome, labels.team, labels.env
| LIMIT 100

panels.title: Token usage per request — prompt, completion, total

config.title: Daily prompt vs completion tokens (APM spans)

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS prompt = SUM(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), completion = SUM(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), total = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| FORK
    (STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) | EVAL kind = "prompt")
    (STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) | EVAL kind = "completion")
| KEEP kind, tokens

config.title: OpenAI completions — input vs output tokens

data_source.query:
FROM logs-openai.completions-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS prompt = SUM(openai.completions.input_tokens), completion = SUM(openai.completions.output_tokens) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

config.title: Vertex AI — prompt vs candidate tokens

data_source.query:
FROM logs-gcp_vertexai.prompt_response_logs-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS prompt = SUM(gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_response.usage_metadata.prompt_token_count), completion = SUM(gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_response.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count) BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

panels.title: LLM cost — model, user, feature, team

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS cost_usd = SUM(cost), tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens), calls = COUNT(*) BY model = gen_ai.request.model
| SORT cost_usd DESC
| LIMIT 15

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS cost_usd = SUM(cost), tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens) BY team = COALESCE(labels.team, "untagged")
| SORT cost_usd DESC

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS cost_usd = SUM(cost), tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens), calls = COUNT(*) BY feature = service.name
| SORT cost_usd DESC

FROM logs-openai.completions-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS tokens = SUM(openai.base.usage_tokens), requests = SUM(openai.base.num_model_requests) BY user = openai.base.user_id
| SORT tokens DESC
| LIMIT 15

config.title: Cost × tokens by model and provider

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS cost_usd = SUM(cost), prompt = SUM(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), completion = SUM(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), calls = COUNT(*) BY model = gen_ai.request.model, provider = gen_ai.system
| SORT cost_usd DESC

config.title: Vertex AI tokens by user and app

data_source.query:
FROM logs-gcp_vertexai.prompt_response_logs-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS tokens = SUM(gcp.vertexai.prompt_response_logs.full_response.usage_metadata.total_token_count), calls = COUNT(*) BY user = user.name, feature = service.name, team = labels.team
| SORT tokens DESC
| LIMIT 30

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS p50_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 50) / 1000

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS errors = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure", calls = COUNT(*)
| EVAL error_rate = errors * 1.0 / calls
| KEEP error_rate

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS calls = COUNT(*) BY outcome = event.outcome

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000, p50_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 50) / 1000 BY model = gen_ai.request.model
| SORT p95_ms DESC
| LIMIT 15

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000 BY day = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1d)
| SORT day

panels.title: Funnel — which user flows consume the most tokens

config.content: Each `service.name` is a Meridian user flow (`checkout-assistant`, `support-copilot`, `rag-research`, `skunk-agent-lab`, …). Ranked by total tokens, then cost and calls. Shadow-IT (`skunk-agent-lab`, `prompt-playground`) and the agent-loop scenario show up here.

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens), cost_usd = SUM(cost), calls = COUNT(*) BY flow = service.name
| SORT tokens DESC

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens) BY flow = service.name
| SORT tokens DESC

config.title: Flow funnel — tokens, prompt/completion split, cost, latency

data_source.query:
FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND span.subtype == "gen_ai"
| EVAL cost = TO_DOUBLE(labels.llm_cost_usd)
| STATS calls = COUNT(*), prompt = SUM(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), completion = SUM(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), tokens = SUM(gen_ai.usage.total_tokens), cost_usd = SUM(cost), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(span.duration.us, 95) / 1000 BY flow = service.name, team = COALESCE(labels.team, "untagged"), env = COALESCE(labels.env, service.environment)
| EVAL tokens_per_call = tokens / calls
| SORT tokens DESC
